author: profbananaslug
body:
1. Craft a boat!


2. Pillar up to the height limit!


3. Make a small platform!


4. Place a boat!


Then boat away!


Enjoy getting spammed by random error messages and getting stuck in midair when the map cycles!


Enjoy many fun boat activities, like shooting people off and more!
